apiEndpoint.title: SOC API endpoint
apiEndpoint.description: Base URL of the SOCLens backend, e.g. https://shield.example.com. Events go to POST /v1/events, blocklist from GET /v1/blocklist.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Bearer token for the backend (per tenant).

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Client / tenant identifier attached to every event.

userId.title: User identifier
userId.description: Optional user or device label attached to events (e.g. UPN pushed per user).

corporateDomains.title: Corporate domains
corporateDomains.description: The organisation's own domains. Trusted everywhere; the corporate password may be typed here.

corporateLoginDomains.title: Corporate login domains
corporateLoginDomains.description: Login pages where the corporate password is learned (as a salted hash). Add ADFS / Okta / VPN portals here.

extraBrands.title: Extra protected brands
extraBrands.description: Brands to protect from impersonation (e.g. the client's own company).

domainAgeLookup.title: Domain age lookup (RDAP)
domainAgeLookup.description: Looks up registration date of already-suspicious domains via rdap.org.

allowUserBypass.title: Allow user bypass
allowUserBypass.description: If false, users cannot proceed past a block or trust a site.

verifyEnabled.title: SOCLens Verify
verifyEnabled.description: Record sign-ins on identity-provider pages (Microsoft, Google, Okta, corporate login domains) and send heartbeats, so the console can answer 'was this really the user?' for SIEM identity alerts. Shows 'Was this you?' prompts.

communityEndpoint.title: Community server
communityEndpoint.description: Optional self-enrolling SOCLens community console (https). Empty = no community server.
